1
Kar Na Ali Da Inkar Dub Jawein Ga Wich Kaar.
Sanu Ali De Nal Pyar Rab V Aida Hubdar.
Apne Layi Rab Jehra Ghar Banwaya Aye Oss Ghar Wich Mera Maula Ali Aaya Aye.
Mukya Nabi Da Intezar Kita Ali Da Way Dedar Veer Way Mera Nayi Jay Yaar.
Rab V Aida Hubdar.Teriyaan Bazurgaan Nu Ali Si Pachanda Sadqay Main Jawaan Tere Kabay Wich Aan Da.
Kita Nabi Ne Iqrar Nasna Aye Tusaan Kayi Waar Ali Way Mera Sardar.
Rab V Aida Hubdar.Buttaan Kolon Rab Ghar Khali Karwana Aye Mirza Khuda Aithay Sajdah Karana Aye.
Ali Si Aida Haqdar Jashan Mananday Azadar Kabay Te Aayi Aye Bahar.
Rab V Aida Hubdar.

item.text:
Reconstructed all nine verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions have one stanza with nine corresponding lines.

Updated the language metadata to Punjabi because the verse grammar uses forms such as *sanu*, *de nal*, and *wich*. I read the ambiguous Roman *aida* as ایہدا and *nasna* as نسنا.
